newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigerian bourse trading to be automated this year.
newsitem.headline: Nigerian bourse trading to be automated this year.

text.p: Share trading on the Nigerian stock market will be automated this year, Hayford Alile, the director general of the exchange, said on Friday.
Alile told reporters that the market would move from the current call-over trading to an automated system.
"According to our strategic plan we should move to an automated trading system in the second or third quarter of 1997," Alile said.
This is expected to come after the introduction of a computerised settlement and custodian system scheduled for the end of the first quarter of this year.
"We just want to fully digest the central securities clearing system (CSCS) before automating trading," he said.
Experts from Canada late last year completed installing the software for the system, leaving the training of its users as the main hurdle left.
"The system will enhance the value of our securities and will place us in the league of modern economies," said Alile.
